notes.title: Shibainu VR Katana Simulator Development Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41895700/fa143ccf615d5a78ee3690ef9079cf673f8c423c.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

I wanted to give you all an update on the development of Shibainu. I know many of you have been waiting for more updates, and I apologize for the delays.

I am happy to report that the work is well underway and making great progress. One of the main goals for the next update is the port to Unreal Engine 5. However, the process is taking longer than I initially anticipated.

But I assure you, the wait will be worth it! The new Unreal Engine 5 will bring some exciting new features to the game. Some of the highlights include advanced procedural cuts, optimization in several systems, a wider variety of targets to challenge your skills, and new game modes to keep things fresh and interesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41895700/873eb1568e0c42a627d4c04f7e9d8724ec8fedea.gif[/img]

You can see the development roadmap (with estimated dates) in the following link: https://github.com/users/HernanOlave/projects/4/views/3

For the latest news, join the discord channel: https://discord.com/invite/SUDkgEMTtJ

I am excited about these new features and can't wait for you to try them out. I will continue to keep you updated on the progress and will let you know as soon as the update is ready for release.

Thank you for your patience and continued support.

Best regards, 
Volrath

tags.feature: Some of the highlights include advanced procedural cuts, optimization in several systems, a wider variety of targets to challenge your skills, and new game modes to keep things fresh and interesting.
